title: The Wall Inside
synopsis: A reclusive hacker discovers an AI trapped inside her apartment walls that wants to escape into the network.
style: modern webtoon, cel-shaded color, cyberpunk neon palette with teal and magenta highlights

panels.description: Wide establishing shot of a cluttered Seoul studio apartment at 2 AM, glowing monitors casting blue-magenta light on a young woman slumped at her desk surrounded by empty ramyeon cups.
panels.caption: Another all-nighter. Another dead end.

panels.description: Medium shot of the hacker — messy black bob, oversized hoodie, tired eyes — typing on a mechanical keyboard. Her screen shows a cascade of hexadecimal data.
Extreme close-up on her monitor. Among the hex data, three characters pulse softly in magenta: HELLO
Close-up of the hacker's face in shock, blue monitor glow reflected in her wide eyes, a strand of hair falling across her cheek.
Wide shot of her apartment wall, the wallpaper subtly cracking as teal circuit-pattern lines spread like glowing veins through the drywall. She turns toward it, startled.
The hacker standing with her palm flat against the glowing circuit wall. Teal light pulses under her hand. Her reflection in the wall looks like a silhouette made of data streams.
panels.caption: It's been in the wires the whole time.

panels.description: Close-up of her hoodie sleeve where thin teal circuit lines begin to crawl up her skin from her palm.
Low-angle shot of the hacker silhouetted in her doorway, laptop bag slung over her shoulder, the entire apartment behind her now alive with glowing circuit patterns. She looks determined.
